newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea intervenes again to support won.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea intervenes again to support won.

text.p: South Korea's central Bank of Korea stepped in again in mid-afternoon trading to boost the won against the dollar, dealers said.
They said the BOK sold dollars at the 828.80 level.
"The central bank stepped in again as the dollar continued to strengthen due to rising importer settlements and dollar position build-ups," said a dealer with a foreign bank.
The won rose to 827.90 about 10 minutes after the BOK intervention. It opened at 829 and moved between 827.30 and 829.80.
Dealers forecast trading would range from 827.50 to 828.50 for the rest of afternoon session.
